subject: load of dynamite
text: At Bob's store, Bob provides a load of dynamite to blast through rock walls.

evidence.quote:
Bob: Welcome to Bob's store! You came here for supplies to blast thru rock 
walls, huh? This should get you started.
You've got a load of dynamite.

text: Bob tells Mike that if he strikes gold, Bob will buy it all.

evidence.quote: Bob: If you strike gold, I'll buy it all. Good luck!

evidence.quote:
(If you choose yes)
You are indeed very brave! I hereby christen you, Sir Mike!
(Arthur raises his sword. The sword flashes then he swings it to the right then 
back to the left.)
Your life level is increased!
Arthur: You are now a knight of the round table. Good luck on your journey!

subject: Hirocon
text: Merlin states that his friend Hirocon spread the Tetrads across time and space so that only a hero could find them and put them all together.

evidence.quote:
Merlin: Call me Merlin. I am the magician in King Arthur's court. Long ago I 
had a good friend from a faraway planet. His name was Hirocon. He spread the 
Tetrads across time and space so that only a hero could find them. When we last 
spoke, he asked me to watch over such a hero in his journey someday. That hero 
was you, Sir Mike, and that day has come. You must now collect the last Tetrad 
and put them all together. The fate of Hirocon's race rests on you.

subject: Hirocon
text: Hirocon explains that when trouble began on Argonia, he had his essence transferred to the Tetrads after sending Mica away in the escape pod.

evidence.quote:
Hirocon: Mica! I'm so glad that you arrived here safely! When trouble began on 
Argonia, I sent you away in the escape pod... ... And then had my essence 
transferred to those Tetrads. Now thanks to Mike, we are all safe...
